unitTitle: Past Simple - A/An/The - Will - Linking Words

sections.title: Past Simple — Alexander Graham Bell
sections.titleUz: Oddiy o'tgan zamon — Aleksandr Grexem Bell

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in lectured, moved, was, invented, began, died, opened, married.
exercises.instructionUz: lectured, moved, was, invented, began, died, opened, married so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Alexander Graham Bell WAS a famous inventor. He was born
  on 3rd March, 1847 in Edinburgh, Scotland.

  Bell graduated from Edinburgh's Royal High School in 1861
  and BEGAN his first studies in sound in 1864 at Elgin's
  West House Academy. In 1870, together with his family, he
  MOVED to Canada. In 1871 he LECTURED in Boston, USA,
  about how to teach speech to the deaf and in 1872 he
  OPENED his own school for training teachers of the deaf
  in Boston. He became a professor at Boston University in
  1873. Bell INVENTED the telephone in 1876. He MARRIED
  Mabel Hubbard a year later and in 1880 he invented the
  gramophone. He was granted eighteen patents for his
  inventions.

  Alexander Graham Bell DIED on 2nd August 1922, on Cape
  Breton Island, Canada.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Aleksandr Grexem Bell mashhur ixtirochi edi. U 1847-yil
  3-martda Shotlandiyaning Edinburg shahrida tug'ilgan.
  Bell 1861-yilda Edinburgdagi Qirollik oliy maktabini
  tugatdi va 1864-yilda Elginning West House akademiyasida
  tovush ustidagi ilk tadqiqotlarini boshladi. 1870-yilda
  oilasi bilan birga Kanadaga ko'chib o'tdi. 1871-yilda
  AQShning Boston shahrida karlarga nutqni qanday
  o'rgatish haqida ma'ruza qildi va 1872-yilda Bostonda
  karlar o'qituvchilarini tayyorlash uchun o'z maktabini
  ochdi. 1873-yilda Boston universitetida professor bo'ldi.
  Bell 1876-yilda telefonni ixtiro qildi. Bir yildan keyin
  Mabel Xabbardga uylandi va 1880-yilda grammofonni ixtiro
  qildi. Unga ixtirolari uchun o'n sakkizta patent berildi.
  Aleksandr Grexem Bell 1922-yil 2-avgustda Kanadaning
  Keyp-Breton orolida vafot etdi.


XRONOLOGIK TARTIB (sanalarga qarab tekshiring):
  1847 — tug'ilgan
  1861 — maktabni tugatgan
  1864 — tadqiqotni BOSHLAGAN
  1870 — Kanadaga KO'ChIB O'TGAN
  1871 — Bostonda MA'RUZA qilgan
  1872 — maktab OChGAN
  1873 — professor bo'lgan
  1876 — telefonni IXTIRO QILGAN
  1877 — UYLANGAN ('a year later')
  1880 — grammofonni ixtiro qilgan
  1922 — VAFOT ETGAN

USUL: har bir bo'shliqning atrofidagi so'zlarga qarang.
  ... to Canada        → harakat → moved
  ... his own school   → ochish  → opened
  ... the telephone    → ixtiro  → invented
  ... Mabel Hubbard    → nikoh   → married

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an inventor    = ixtirochi
  to graduate from = ...ni tugatmoq
  studies        = tadqiqotlar, o'qish
  sound          = tovush
  to move        = ko'chib o'tmoq
  to lecture     = ma'ruza qilmoq
  speech         = nutq
  the deaf       = karlar
  training       = tayyorlash, o'qitish
  a gramophone   = grammofon
  to be granted  = berilmoq
  a patent       = patent
  an invention   = ixtiro

items.textEn: 1  Alexander Graham Bell ............ a famous inventor.
items.whyUz:
Kasb aytilyapti → 'to be' fe'li kerak.
'Alexander Graham Bell' BIRLIK → WAS.
'an inventor' = ixtirochi.

items.textEn: 2  ... and ............ his first studies in sound in 1864.
items.whyUz:
'BEGAN his first studies' = ilk tadqiqotlarini boshladi.
begin → BEGAN (NOTO'G'RI fe'l).
'sound' = tovush — bu keyinchalik telefonga olib kelgan.

items.textEn: 3  In 1870, together with his family, he ............ to Canada.
items.whyUz:
'MOVED to Canada' = Kanadaga ko'chib o'tdi.
'to move' = ko'chib o'tmoq (yashash joyini o'zgartirmoq).
TO'G'RI fe'l: move → moved (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).

items.textEn: 4  In 1871 he ............ in Boston, USA, about how to teach speech to the deaf.
items.whyUz:
'LECTURED in Boston about ...' = ...haqida ma'ruza qildi.
'to lecture' = ma'ruza qilmoq.
TO'G'RI fe'l: lecture → lectured.
'the deaf' = karlar (sifat + 'the' → butun guruh).

items.textEn: 5  ... and in 1872 he ............ his own school for training teachers of the deaf.
items.whyUz:
'OPENED his own school' = o'z maktabini ochdi.
TO'G'RI fe'l: open → opened.
DIQQAT: urg'u BIRINCHI bo'g'inda (O-pen) —
shuning uchun 'n' IKKILANMAYDI.
'his own' = o'zining.

items.textEn: 6  Bell ............ the telephone in 1876.
items.whyUz:
'INVENTED the telephone' = telefonni ixtiro qildi.
TO'G'RI fe'l: invent → invented.
Bu — Bellning eng mashhur ishi.
Matnda keyinroq: 'he invented the gramophone' — takrorlangan.

items.textEn: 7  He ............ Mabel Hubbard a year later.
items.whyUz:
'MARRIED Mabel Hubbard' = Mabel Xabbardga uylandi.
TO'G'RI fe'l: marry → married ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
DIQQAT: 'married WITH' XATO — 'with' KERAK EMAS.
'a year later' = bir yildan keyin (ya'ni 1877).

items.textEn: 8  Alexander Graham Bell ............ on 2nd August 1922.
items.whyUz:
'DIED on 2nd August 1922' = 1922-yil 2-avgustda vafot etdi.
TO'G'RI fe'l: die → died (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
'ON 2nd August' — aniq sana → ON.

exercises.instructionEn: First, put the verbs into the interrogative form of the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonning so'roq shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ QOLIPI:
  [savol so'zi] + DID + EGA + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  What time DID YOU GET to work this morning?

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT:
  'did' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda —
  o'tgan shaklda EMAS:
     did you GET   ✓
     did you GOT   ✗ XATO
     did she GO    ✓
     did she WENT  ✗ XATO

NOTO'G'RI FE'LLARDA bu ayniqsa muhim:
  get → asosiy shakl 'get'
  go  → asosiy shakl 'go'
  leave → asosiy shakl 'leave'
  have → asosiy shakl 'have'
  buy → asosiy shakl 'buy'
  see → asosiy shakl 'see'

DIQQAT — 'WHOSE':
  'Whose book did you borrow?' = Kimning kitobini olding?
  'whose' = kimning (egalik so'raladi).
  'who's' (= who is) BILAN ADAShTIRMANG.

items.textEn: 1  What time ............ (you/get) to work this morning?
items.whyUz:
did + you + GET (asosiy shakl).
'get to work' = ishga yetib bormoq.

items.textEn: 2  Where ............ (she/go) on holiday?
items.whyUz:
did + she + GO ('went' EMAS).
'go ON holiday' — predlog ON.

items.textEn: 3  Why ............ (he/leave) the party early?
items.whyUz:
did + he + LEAVE ('left' EMAS).
'to leave' = ketmoq;  'early' = erta.

items.textEn: 4  Whose book ............ (you/borrow) yesterday?
items.whyUz:
did + you + BORROW.
'to borrow' = qarzga olmoq (Workbook 36-betda ham bor).
'whose' = kimning (egalik so'raladi).

items.textEn: 5  What ............ (you/have) for breakfast?
items.whyUz:
did + you + HAVE ('had' EMAS).
'have breakfast' = nonushta qilmoq.
'breakfast' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.textEn: 6  Where ............ (Brian/work) last summer?
items.whyUz:
did + Brian + WORK.
Ega olmosh emas, ISM bo'lsa ham qolip bir xil.
'last summer' = o'tgan yoz.

items.textEn: 7  When ............ (Margaret/buy) a computer?
items.whyUz: did + Margaret + BUY ('bought' EMAS).

items.textEn: 8  What film ............ (you/see) last night?
items.whyUz:
did + you + SEE ('saw' EMAS).
'What film ...?' — 'what' otdan oldin ham kelishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Then match the questions to the answers, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ JAVOB:
  a  At 9:30 am.                  (vaqt)
  b  He was tired.                (sabab)
  c  Bacon and eggs.              (ovqat)
  d  On Tuesday.                  (kun)
  e  At his father's supermarket. (joy)
  f  Asterix and Obelix.          (film nomi)
  g  To Paris.                    (yo'nalish)
  h  Michelle's.                  (kimning)

Kitob BIRINI bergan: 1 → a

USUL — SAVOL SO'ZIGA QARANG:
  What time ...? → soat  → a
  Where ...?     → joy   → e yoki g
  Why ...?       → sabab → b
  Whose ...?     → kimning → h
  What ... for breakfast? → ovqat → c
  When ...?      → kun   → d
  What film ...? → film nomi → f

DIQQAT — IKKI 'WHERE' SAVOLI:
  2-savol: 'Where did she go ON HOLIDAY?' → yo'nalish → g (To Paris)
  6-savol: 'Where did Brian WORK?' → ish joyi → e (At his father's supermarket)
  Javobdagi predlog yordam beradi:
     TO Paris    → harakat (go)
     AT ... supermarket → joy (work)

pairs.left: 1  What time did you get to work this morning?
pairs.leftUz: Bugun ertalab ishga qaysi soatda yetib bording?
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA BERILGAN.
'What time ...?' → aniq SOAT javobi.

pairs.left: 2  Where did she go on holiday?
pairs.whyUz:
'go' harakat fe'li → javobda 'TO' predlogi.
6-savol bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'AT'.

pairs.left: 3  Why did he leave the party early?
4  Whose book did you borrow yesterday?
5  What did you have for breakfast?
pairs.whyUz:
'What ... for breakfast?' → OVQAT javobi.
'bacon and eggs' — an'anaviy ingliz nonushtasi.

pairs.left: 6  Where did Brian work last summer?
pairs.whyUz:
'work' — joy fe'li → javobda 'AT' predlogi.
"his father'S supermarket" — egalik apostrofi.

pairs.left: 7  When did Margaret buy a computer?
pairs.whyUz:
'When ...?' → VAQT javobi.
'ON Tuesday' — hafta kuni bilan ON.

pairs.left: 8  What film did you see last night?
pairs.whyUz:
'What film ...?' → FILM NOMI javobi.
'Asterix and Obelix' — mashhur fransuz komiks qahramonlari.

exercises.instructionEn: Answer the questions, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  What time did you go to school this morning?
  I WENT to school at nine o'clock.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT:
  SAVOLda:  did you GO    (ASOSIY shakl)
  JAVOBda:  I WENT        (O'TGAN shakl)

  Savolda 'did' bor edi — javobda 'did' YO'Q,
  shuning uchun fe'lning O'ZI o'tgan shaklga o'tadi.

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  Savoldagi so'zlarni QAYTARIB, savol so'zi o'rniga
  aniq ma'lumot qo'yasiz.

JAVOBLAR SHAXSIY — quyida namuna javoblar berilgan.

items.textEn: 1  What time did you go to school this morning?
items.answer: I went to school at nine o'clock.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'GO' (asosiy), javobda 'WENT' (o'tgan).
'AT nine o'clock' — soat bilan AT.

items.textEn: 2  Who did you go on a picnic with?
items.answer: I went on a picnic with my friends.
items.whyUz:
'go ON a picnic' — predlog ON.
Savolda 'with' OXIRIDA edi, javobda esa
to'ldiruvchidan oldin: 'with my friends'.

items.textEn: 3  What did you study at university?
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'STUDY' (asosiy), javobda 'STUDIED' (o'tgan).
'AT university' — artikl YO'Q (o'qish ma'nosida).

items.textEn: 4  When did you call Ben?
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'CALL', javobda 'CALLED'.
'to call' = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.

items.textEn: 5  What did you cook for dinner?
items.answer: I cooked chicken and rice for dinner.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'COOK', javobda 'COOKED'.
'for dinner' — 'dinner' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.textEn: 6  Who did you invite to the party?
items.answer: I invited my classmates to the party.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'INVITE', javobda 'INVITED'.
'invite somebody TO a place' — predlog TO.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions in the past simple, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Oddiy o'tgan zamonda savollar yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  When (you/make) a cake?
  → When DID YOU MAKE a cake?

QOLIP:
  [savol so'zi] + DID + EGA + ASOSIY FE'L + qolgan qismi?

BARCHA O'N BANDDA BIR XIL QOLIP.
Faqat savol so'zi, ega va fe'l o'zgaradi.

DIQQAT — 'DID' DAN KEYIN DOIM ASOSIY SHAKL:
  did you MAKE   ✓   did you MADE    ✗
  did she WEAR   ✓   did she WORE    ✗
  did he GO      ✓   did he WENT     ✗
  did Andrew BUY ✓   did Andrew BOUGHT ✗
  did you LEAVE  ✓   did you LEFT    ✗
  did he DO      ✓   did he DID      ✗

ENG G'ALATI BAND — 10-BAND:
  'What DID he DO ...?'
  Bitta gapda 'do' IKKI MARTA:
     birinchi 'did' — YORDAMCHI fe'l
     ikkinchi 'do'  — ASOSIY fe'l
  Bu to'g'ri va normal.

items.question: When did you make a cake?
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
When + did + you + MAKE ('made' EMAS).

items.question: What did she wear to the party?
items.whyUz:
did + she + WEAR ('wore' EMAS).
'to wear' = kiymoq;  wear → wore (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'TO the party' — predlog TO.

items.question: Where did he go last night?
items.whyUz:
did + he + GO ('went' EMAS).
'last night' = kecha kechqurun.

items.question: When did you tidy your room?
items.whyUz:
did + you + TIDY ('tidied' EMAS).
'to tidy' = yig'ishtirmoq.

items.question: Who did you visit last week?
items.whyUz:
did + you + VISIT.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'who' TO'LDIRUVChI ('kimni'),
shuning uchun 'did' KERAK.
(Agar 'who' EGA bo'lsa — 'Who visited you?' — 'did' kerak emas.)

items.question: When did you wash the car?
items.whyUz:
did + you + WASH.
Coursebook 74-betdagi 18-mashqda ham bor edi.

items.question: Where did she go for a walk?
items.whyUz:
did + she + GO.
'go FOR a walk' = sayr qilmoq — predlog FOR.

items.question: What did Andrew buy at the weekend?
items.whyUz:
did + Andrew + BUY ('bought' EMAS).
'AT the weekend' — britancha;  amerikacha 'ON the weekend'.

items.question: When did you leave for work?
items.whyUz:
did + you + LEAVE ('left' EMAS).
'leave FOR a place' = biror joyga jo'namoq.

items.question: What did he do for his birthday?
items.whyUz:
did + he + DO.
DIQQAT: 'do' IKKI MARTA chiqadi —
birinchisi YORDAMCHI ('did'), ikkinchisi ASOSIY ('do').
Bu to'g'ri: 'What did he do?'

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to make questions and answers in the past simple, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib oddiy o'tgan zamonda savol va javoblar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  A: What (you/do) last night?
  B: I (watch) TV.
  →
  A: What DID YOU DO last night?
  B: I WATCHED TV.

IKKI XIL SHAKL BIR DIALOGDA:
  SAVOL (A):  DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l
  JAVOB (B):  ega + O'TGAN fe'l

  Savolda 'did' bor → asosiy shakl.
  Javobda 'did' yo'q → o'tgan shakl.

BU — ENG KO'P XATO QILINADIGAN JOY.
Har bir dialogda ikkala shaklga ham e'tibor bering.

items.prompt: 1  A: What (you/do) last night?  B: I (watch) TV.
items.question: What did you do last night?
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Savolda 'DO' (asosiy shakl), javobda 'WATCHED' (o'tgan shakl).
'watch TV' — 'TV' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.prompt: 2  A: When (you/buy) those trousers?  B: I (buy) them on Tuesday.
items.question: When did you buy those trousers?
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'BUY' (asosiy shakl).
Javobda 'BOUGHT' (o'tgan shakl) — bu yerda 'did' yo'q.
DIQQAT: bir dialogda BIR XIL fe'l ikki xil shaklda:
  did you BUY  →  I BOUGHT
'trousers' — DOIM ko'plikda ('a trouser' YO'Q).
'ON Tuesday' — hafta kuni bilan ON.

items.prompt: 3  A: Where (she/go) on holiday?  B: She (go) to Portugal.
items.question: Where did she go on holiday?
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'GO' (asosiy shakl).
Javobda 'WENT' (o'tgan shakl).
DIQQAT: yana bir xil fe'l ikki xil shaklda:
  did she GO  →  She WENT
'go ON holiday' — predlog ON;
'go TO Portugal' — yo'nalish bilan TO.

wordFormation.introUz: 44-bet — so'roq va javobdagi fe'l shakllari, ixtiro lug'ati.

groups.ruleUz: SO'ROQ va JAVOBDA fe'l shakli — eng muhim farq
groups.explanationUz: 'did' bor bo'lsa asosiy shakl, yo'q bo'lsa o'tgan shakl.

groups.ruleUz: Savol so'zlari va ular so'raydigan ma'lumot

patterns.exampleEn: When did you make a cake? Where did she go on holiday?
patterns.exampleUz: Qachon tort pishirding? U ta'tilga qayerga bordi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'did' dan keyin DOIM asosiy shakl —
noto'g'ri fe'llarda ham.

patterns.formula: SAVOL: DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   →   JAVOB: ega + O'TGAN fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: When did you buy those trousers? — I bought them on Tuesday.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu shimni qachon sotib olding? — Seshanba kuni sotib oldim.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir dialogda bir xil fe'l IKKI xil shaklda.
Savolda 'did' bor, javobda yo'q.

patterns.exampleEn: Whose book did you borrow yesterday? — Michelle's.
patterns.explanationUz:
'whose' = kimning.
Javobda ot TAKRORLANMAYDI — faqat apostrof + s.

patterns.exampleEn: In 1870, together with his family, he moved to Canada.
patterns.exampleUz: 1870-yilda oilasi bilan birga Kanadaga ko'chib o'tdi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'move TO a place' = biror joyga ko'chib o'tmoq.

patterns.formula: Ega + INVENTED / OPENED / LECTURED ... IN + yil.
patterns.exampleEn: Bell invented the telephone in 1876. He opened his own school in 1872.
patterns.exampleUz: Bell 1876-yilda telefonni ixtiro qildi. 1872-yilda o'z maktabini ochdi.
patterns.explanationUz: Tarjimai holda voqealar XRONOLOGIK tartibda beriladi.

patterns.exampleEn: What did he do for his birthday?
patterns.explanationUz:
'do' fe'li ikki marta: 'did' — yordamchi, 'do' — asosiy.
Bu TO'G'RI qolip.
